dung_blackbox_storager_1.name: Belt-free Transfer
dung_blackbox_storager_1.desc: You must move a batch of Originium Ore to the Depot. Complete the power grid and use the belt-free transfer of the Protocol Stash to transport the ore back to the depot.
dung_blackbox_storager_1.featureDesc:
Use the <@bl.key>Electric Pylon</> to power the <@bl.key>Protocol Stash</> and activate its belt-free transfer feature. 
<@bl.key>Belt-free transfer</> lets the Stash transport its contents straight to the Depot. 
An <@bl.key>Electric Pylon</> connected to the power grid will supply power to facilities within range. 
Transmit power from the <@bl.key>Relay Tower</> to the <@bl.key>Electric Pylon</> to connect it into the power grid.

dung_blackbox_miner_2.name: Electric Mining Rig Mk II
dung_blackbox_miner_2.desc: Use Electric Mining Rigs Mk II to mine every mining spot of the area.
dung_blackbox_miner_2.featureDesc:
<@bl.key>Electric Mining Rigs</> can mine Originium Ore and Amethyst Ore. 
<@bl.key>Electric Mining Rigs Mk II</> can mine Originium Ore, Amethyst Ore, and Ferrium Ore.

dung_blackbox_xiraniteoven_1.name: Forge of the Sky
dung_blackbox_xiraniteoven_1.desc: Forges of the Sky are Wuling-exclusive facilities that produce Xiranite. Use them to create a Xiranite production line.
dung_blackbox_xiraniteoven_1.featureDesc: <@bl.key>Forges of the Sky</> are facilities that produce <@bl.key>Xiranite</>. Use the <@bl.key>blueprint</> feature to quickly construct a <@bl.key>Xiranite</> production line.

dung_blackbox_mix_2.name: Reactor Expansion
dung_blackbox_mix_2.desc: Expand the Reactor Crucible cache to produce different solutions simultaneously. Improve the current production line to reduce the number of Reactor Crucibles needed.
dung_blackbox_mix_2.featureDesc:
Expanding the <@bl.key>Reactor Crucible</> cache lets you <@bl.key>simultaneously</> produce different solutions. 
Move Clean Water, Jincao Powder, and Yazhen Powder into an expanded <@bl.key>Reactor Crucible</> to simultaneously produce <@bl.key>Jincao Solution</> and <@bl.key>Yazhen Solution</>.

dung_blackbox_mix_1.name: Reactor Crucible
dung_blackbox_mix_1.desc: Reactor Crucibles can react solid material with fluids to create solutions. Add powdered plants and Clean Water into the Reactor Crucible to produce plant solutions.
dung_blackbox_mix_1.featureDesc:
Transport Jincao Powder and Clean Water into the <@bl.key>Reactor Crucible</> to produce Jincao Solution. 
Connect the Reactor Crucible to the Fluid Tank with <@bl.key>pipes</> to transport fluid products from the Reactor Crucible to the Fluid Tank. Remember to <@bl.key>set</> the desired fluid output at the Reactor Crucible. 
Drag <@bl.key>empty bottles</> to a filled Fluid Tank to <@bl.key>bottle the fluid</>.

dung_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2.name: Heavy Xiranite
dung_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2.desc: Clean Water and Xiranite can be used to produce Liquid Xiranite. This can undergo additional reaction steps to yield Heavy Xiranite. Use the Forge of the Sky to produce Heavy Xiranite.
dung_blackbox_xiraniteoven_2.featureDesc:
With a supply of <@bl.key>Clean Water</>, the Reactor Crucible can dissolve Xiranite in liquid to produce <@bl.key>Liquid Xiranite</>.
Liquid Xiranite and Sewage can be further reacted in the Reactor Crucible to produce <@bl.key>Xircon Effluent</>.
Finally, input Xircon Effluent and Xiranite into a Forge of the Sky to produce <@bl.key>Heavy Xiranite</>.

dung_blackbox_udpipe_1.name: Conduit
dung_blackbox_udpipe_1.desc: Conduits are underground pipes that can transport fluids without being affected by ground surface obstruction. Use conduits to bring Clean Water to the facility and start producing Cuprium.
dung_blackbox_udpipe_1.featureDesc:
<@bl.key>Conduit Inlets</> can transport fluids to underground conduits
<@bl.key>Conduit Outlets</> can transport fluids out of underground conduits
Use the <@bl.key>Conduit Inlet</> and <@bl.key>Conduit Outlet</> to transport Clean Water needed for Cuprium production

dung_blackbox_liquidpurifier_1.name: Purification Unit
dung_blackbox_liquidpurifier_1.desc: The Purification Unit can purify solutions. Use the Purification Unit to complete the production line to purify Cuprium Solution into Hetonite Solution.
dung_blackbox_liquidpurifier_1.featureDesc:
The <@bl.key>Purification Unit</> can purify solutions. For example, it can process Cuprium Solution into Hetonite Solution. 
Move the <@bl.key>Precipitation Acid</> produced by the Purification Unit to the <@bl.key>Reactor Crucible</> for reaction to produce even more Cuprium Solution.
The Purification Unit control panel shows <@bl.key>2 outlets</>. The top outlet provides Precipitation Acid while the bottom outlet provides Hetonite Solution.

dung_blackbox_converger_1.name: Converger
dung_blackbox_converger_1.desc: The AIC Factory can now utilize the Converger that converges product flows of multiple transport belts into a single belt.
dung_blackbox_converger_1.featureDesc: The <@bl.key>Converger</> can merge up to 3 belts into 1 belt to combine product flows.

dung_aglina_chartrial.name: Combat Drills: Gilberta
dung_aglina_chartrial.desc: Gilberta is a supporter with both Arts and Physical abilities. She can quickly Lift enemies after triggering Arts Reactions. Once cast, her ultimate also applies Arts Susceptibility to enemies within a large area.

dung_blackbox_assebling_1.name: Packaging Unit
dung_blackbox_assebling_1.desc: Use the Packaging Unit to set up an automatic LC Valley Battery production line and charge the combat facilities.
dung_blackbox_assebling_1.featureDesc:
Place Amethyst Parts and Originium Powder in the <@bl.key>Packaging Unit</> to produce LC Valley Batteries. 
Place the batteries in the <@bl.key>Grenade Tower</> to charge it.

dung_blackbox_assebling_2.name: SC Valley Battery
dung_blackbox_assebling_2.desc: Use the Packaging Unit to set up an automatic SC Valley Battery production line.
dung_blackbox_assebling_2.featureDesc: Place Ferrium Parts and Originium Powder in the <@bl.key>Packaging Unit</> to produce SC Valley Batteries.

dung_blackbox_asseblingbomb_1.name: Industrial Explosive
dung_blackbox_asseblingbomb_1.desc: Produce Industrial Explosives, then use them to blast apart the rubble and rescue the trapped victims.
dung_blackbox_asseblingbomb_1.featureDesc:
Place Amethyst Part and Aketine Powder in the <@bl.key>Packaging Unit</> to produce Industrial Explosives. 
Open your Backpack and use the <@bl.key>Industrial Explosive</>, aim at the rocks, then throw the explosive to blast the rocks apart.

dung_laevat_chartrial.name: Combat Drills: Laevatain
dung_laevat_chartrial.desc: Laevatain is a striker with outstanding mass DMG skills. Her Final Strikes can absorb Heat Inflictions from nearby enemies to trigger powerful battle skills and combo skills. She can also use her ultimate to carve and burn her way through mobs of enemies.

dung_blackbox_basic_1.name: Material Production
dung_blackbox_basic_1.desc: The Relay Tower is down. Use the right facilities to produce materials for repairing it.
dung_blackbox_basic_1.featureDesc:
Place Originium Ore in the <@bl.key>Refining Unit</> to process it into Origocrust. 
Place Originium Ore in the <@bl.key>Shredding Unit</> to process it into Originium Powder. 
Use the products from these 2 processes to repair the damaged Relay Tower.

dung_blackbox_belt_1.name: Logistics Connections
dung_blackbox_belt_1.desc: A batch of materials must be delivered to AIC facilities for processing and the products must be sent back to the Depot. Connect the current facility layout with transport belts to create a logistics line.
dung_blackbox_belt_1.featureDesc:
<@bl.key>Transport belts</> can automatically deliver raw materials to a processing facility. 
<@bl.key>Transport belts</> can also automatically move processed products to the Depot. 
Move Buckflower into a <@bl.key>Shredding Unit</> to process it into Buckflower Powder.

dung_blackbox_belt_2.name: Belt Integration
dung_blackbox_belt_2.desc: Use the Depot Bus, transport belts, and other logistic facilities to set up a complex production line.
dung_blackbox_belt_2.featureDesc:
Connect the Seed-Picking Unit to <@bl.key>2 Planting Units</> and connect 1 Planting Unit <@bl.key>back to the Seed-Picking Unit</> to create a self-feeding loop. 
Place <@bl.key>Steel Parts</> and <@bl.key>Dense Originium Powder</> into a Packaging Unit to produce HC Valley Batteries.

dung_blackbox_bus_1.name: Depot Bus
dung_blackbox_bus_1.desc: The AIC Factory can now utilize the Depot Bus, a flexible and effective logistics facility.
dung_blackbox_bus_1.featureDesc: Place <@bl.key>Depot Loaders/Unloaders</> along the <@bl.key>Depot Bus</> to move products in or out of the Depot.

dung_blackbox_bus_2.name: Depot Bus Integration
dung_blackbox_bus_2.desc: Use the Depot Bus and transport belts to set up a complex production line.
dung_blackbox_bus_2.featureDesc: Use <@bl.key>Depot Loaders/Unloaders</> to move products in or out of the Depot.

dung_blackbox_cmpt_1.name: Fitting Unit
dung_blackbox_cmpt_1.desc: The Zipline Tower is broken. Use the Fitting Unit to produce Amethyst Parts for repairing the facility.
dung_blackbox_cmpt_1.featureDesc:
Place Amethyst Ore in the <@bl.key>Refining Unit</> to produce Amethyst Fibers. 
Place Amethyst Fibers in the <@bl.key>Fitting Unit</> to produce Amethyst Parts. 
Place the Amethyst Fibers and Originium Powder in the <@bl.key>Packaging Unit</> to produce <@bl.key>LC Valley Batteries</>.

dung_blackbox_conditioner_1.name: Item Control Port
dung_blackbox_conditioner_1.desc: Item Control Ports only allow the passage of a selected item, and can also control the quantity that is allowed to pass through.
dung_blackbox_conditioner_1.featureDesc:
<@bl.key>Item Control Ports</> display the icon of the item that they <@bl.key>allow to pass through</>.
Use the icon to determine the type of items that can be moved along a <@bl.key>transport belt</> with the <@bl.key>Item Control Port</>.

dung_blackbox_connector_1.name: Belt Bridge
dung_blackbox_connector_1.desc: The AIC Factory can now utilize the Belt Bridge that lets a transport belt span another.
dung_blackbox_connector_1.featureDesc: The <@bl.key>Belt Bridge</> allows a transport belt to cross over another without interfering the product flows of both.

dung_blackbox_dismantler_1.name: Separating Unit
dung_blackbox_dismantler_1.desc: The Separating Unit can separate a filled container into the fluid content and the empty container. Use the Separating Unit to complete the Yazhen Syringe [C] production line.
dung_blackbox_dismantler_1.featureDesc:
<@bl.key>Separating Units</> can physically separate certain items. An example would be separating a bottled fluid into an empty bottle and the fluid contents. 
Move Jincao Solution in Ferrium Bottles into the <@bl.key>Separating Unit</> to get empty Ferrium Bottles. 
Move Yazhen Solution in Amethyst Bottles into the <@bl.key>Separating Unit</> to get Yazhen Solution. 
Finally, move Yazhen Solution and empty Ferrium Bottles to the <@bl.key>Filling Unit</> for refilling and produce Yazhen Syringe [C].

dung_blackbox_filling_1.name: Filling Unit
dung_blackbox_filling_1.desc: Use the Filling Unit to set up auto-production lines for food and medicine.
dung_blackbox_filling_1.featureDesc:
Place Buckflower Powder and Amethyst Bottles in the <@bl.key>Filling Unit</> to produce Buck Capsule [C]. 
Place Citrome Powder and Amethyst Bottles in the <@bl.key>Filling Unit</> to produce Canned Citrome [C].

dung_blackbox_filling_2.name: Improved Cannery
dung_blackbox_filling_2.desc: Use the AIC Factory to process Ferrium Ore. Use Ferrium Bottles to produce improved canned citromes.
dung_blackbox_filling_2.featureDesc:
Replace <@bl.key>Amethyst Ore</> of the existing food production line with <@bl.key>Ferrium Ore</> to produce higher quality canned food. 
Transport Ferrium Ore into the <@bl.key>Refining Unit</> to produce Ferrium. 
Transport Ferrium into the <@bl.key>Moulding Unit</> to produce Ferrium Bottles. 
Transport Ferrium Bottles and Citrome Powder into the <@bl.key>Filling Unit</> to produce <@bl.key>Canned Citrome [B]</>.

dung_blackbox_grinder_1.name: Shredding Unit
dung_blackbox_grinder_1.desc: You must powder a batch of materials and transport the products back to the Depot. Connect the current facilities with transport belts to create a production line.
dung_blackbox_grinder_1.featureDesc:
Use <@bl.key>transport belts</> to set up an automated production line that delivers raw materials to the processing unit and then moves the products to the Depot. 
Move Originium Ore to the <@bl.key>Refining Unit</> to produce Origocrust. 
Move Origocrust to the <@bl.key>Shredding Unit</> to produce Origocrust Powder.

dung_blackbox_filling_3.name: Buck Capsule [A]
dung_blackbox_filling_3.desc: Upgrade the medicine production line with the Grinding Unit to produce the improved medicine: Buck Capsule [A].
dung_blackbox_filling_3.featureDesc:
Place Buckflower Powder and Sandleaf Powder into the <@bl.key>Grinding Unit</> to produce <@bl.key>Ground Buckflower Powder</>. 
Place Steel Bottle and Ground Buckflower Powder into the <@bl.key>Filling Unit</> to produce <@bl.key>Buck Capsule [A]</>.

dung_blackbox_filling_4.name: Filling Unit (Fluid)
dung_blackbox_filling_4.desc: Use pipes and Filling Unit Fluid Mode to transport fluids into the facility to produce Wuling food and medicine.
dung_blackbox_filling_4.featureDesc:
Deliver powdered plant material and Clean Water into the <@bl.key>Reactor Crucible</> and mix them to get a plant solution. 
Deliver Ferrium Parts and Jincao Solution in Ferrium Bottles to the <@bl.key>Packaging Unit</> to produce Jincao Drink.
Deliver Ferrium Parts and Yazhen Solution in Ferrium Bottles to the <@bl.key>Packaging Unit</> to produce Yazhen Syringe [C].

dung_blackbox_hub_1.name: Meds Production
dung_blackbox_hub_1.desc: Use the AIC Factory to create an automated Buckflower Powder production line.
dung_blackbox_hub_1.featureDesc:
The <@bl.key>PAC Output Port</> can continuously unload items from the Depot to the transport belt. 
Connect a facility output port to a <@bl.key>PAC Input Port</> with a transport line to move facility products to the Depot. 
Deliver Buckflower to the <@bl.key>Shredding Unit</> to produce <@bl.key>Buckflower Powder</>.

dung_blackbox_liquidcleaner_1.name: Water Treatment Unit
dung_blackbox_liquidcleaner_1.desc: In Fluid Mode, many facilities may create Sewage during production processes. A Water Treatment Unit will be needed to treat the Sewage.
dung_blackbox_liquidcleaner_1.featureDesc: <@bl.key>Water Treatment Units</> can clean up sewage generated during production. Remember to keep emptying the Sewage Cache of the production to prevent clogging of the production line.

dung_blackbox_miner_1.name: Electric Mining Rig
dung_blackbox_miner_1.desc: Mine Amethyst Ore with Electric Mining Rigs, then process the Amethyst Ore into Amethyst Fiber.
dung_blackbox_miner_1.featureDesc:
<@bl.key>Electric Mining Rigs</> can mine Originium Ore and Amethyst Ore. 
Use <@bl.key>Electric Pylons</> to power the <@bl.key>Electric Mining Rigs</>. 
Transmit power from a <@bl.key>Relay Tower</> and plug the power cable into the <@bl.key>Electric Pylon</> to connect it to the power grid.

dung_blackbox_miner_3.name: Hydro Mining Rig
dung_blackbox_miner_3.desc: Hydro Mining Rigs use water to mine, and do not need to be connected to the power grid to work. Mine some Cuprium Ore with Hydro Mining Rigs.
dung_blackbox_miner_3.featureDesc:
<@bl.key>Hydro Mining Rigs</> only need a supply of <@bl.key>Clean Water</> to start mining. 
<@bl.key>Cuprium Ore</> must be mined with <@bl.key>Hydro Mining Rigs</>.

dung_blackbox_mix_3.name: Expanded Crucible
dung_blackbox_mix_3.desc: The Advanced Crucible has more caches to carry out more reactions at the same time.
dung_blackbox_mix_3.featureDesc:
The <@bl.key>Expanded Crucible</> has more caches so that different production formulas can be used <@bl.key>simultaneously</>.
Replace the standard <@bl.key>Reactor Crucibles</> with the <@bl.key>Expanded Crucible</> to improve space usage.

dung_blackbox_pipe_1.name: Pipes and Fluids
dung_blackbox_pipe_1.desc: Use pipes, Fluid Pumps, and Fluid Supply Units to transport various fluids.
dung_blackbox_pipe_1.featureDesc:
Use <@bl.key>Fluid Pumps</> to remove fluids from pools. 
Use <@bl.key>Fluid Supply Units</> to pour fluids into the pool. 
Connect the Fluid Pump to the Fluid Supply Unit with <@bl.key>pipes</> to transport the fluids.

dung_blackbox_pipe_2.name: Pipe Logistics
dung_blackbox_pipe_2.desc: Use pipe logistics units to create a working pipeline and complete the complex production network.
dung_blackbox_pipe_2.featureDesc:
The <@bl.key>Pipe Bridge</> allows a pipeline to cross over another pipeline without interfering the fluid flows of both. 
The <@bl.key>Pipe Converger</> can merge fluid flows from multiple pipelines into a single pipeline.

dung_blackbox_planter_1.name: Planting Unit and Seed-Picking Unit
dung_blackbox_planter_1.desc: Use the Planting Unit and Seed-Picking Unit to create a self-sufficient plant production loop.
dung_blackbox_planter_1.featureDesc:
Place Buckflowers into the <@bl.key>Seed-Picking Unit</> to get Buckflower Seeds. 
Place Buckflower Seeds into the <@bl.key>Planting Unit</> to get Buckflower. 
1 Seed-Picking Unit can supply 2 Planting Units with seeds for optimal production.

dung_blackbox_planter_2.name: Planting Unit and Pipe Splitters
dung_blackbox_planter_2.desc: Planting Unit can use Fluid Mode to grow Wuling plants. You have limited Fluid Pumps. Use Pipe Splitters to supply Clean Water to multiple facilities.
dung_blackbox_planter_2.featureDesc:
In Fluid Mode, the Planting Unit can use Clean Water and Jincao Seed to produce Jincao plant. 
Use the <@bl.key>Pipe Splitter</> to supply multiple facilities with clean water with just 1 Fluid Pump. 
Transport Jincao Powder and Clean Water to the <@bl.key>Reactor Crucible</> to produce Jincao Solution. 
Transport Yazhen Powder and Clean Water to the <@bl.key>Reactor Crucible</> to produce Yazhen Solution.

dung_blackbox_powerstation_1.name: Thermal Bank
dung_blackbox_powerstation_1.desc: Use Thermal Banks to raise the power grid output and restore operations to the AIC facilities.
dung_blackbox_powerstation_1.featureDesc:
The <@bl.key>Thermal Bank</> uses Originium Ore as fuel for power production. 
Connect <@bl.key>Thermal Banks</> to the power grid via <@bl.key>Electric Pylons</> to add their power output to the grid.

dung_blackbox_shaper_1.name: Moulding Unit
dung_blackbox_shaper_1.desc: Use the AIC Factory to create an automated Amethyst Bottle production line to supply containers for making Buck Capsules [C].
dung_blackbox_shaper_1.featureDesc:
Place Amethyst Ore in the <@bl.key>Refining Unit</> to produce Amethyst Fibers. 
Place Amethyst Fibers in the <@bl.key>Moulding Unit</> to produce Amethyst Bottles. 
Once you have Amethyst Bottles and Buckflower Powder, you can use <@bl.key>Crafting</> to make <@bl.key>Buck Capsule [C]</>.

dung_blackbox_splitter_1.name: Splitter
dung_blackbox_splitter_1.desc: The number of production lines is limited by the number of output ports. The AIC Factory now has the Splitter to split a single output belt into 3.
dung_blackbox_splitter_1.featureDesc:
<@bl.key>Splitters</> can split 1 transport belt into 3 to supply more facilities. 
A <@bl.key>Splitter</> has 1 input and 3 outputs. Connect the input belt to the Splitter's input, then connect up to 3 output belts to achieve splitting.

dung_blackbox_squirter_1.name: Sprinkler
dung_blackbox_squirter_1.desc: Use pipes, Fluid Pumps, and Sprinklers to auto-irrigate the plots.
dung_blackbox_squirter_1.featureDesc:
<@bl.key>Sprinklers</> auto-irrigate farm plots when they need water. 
A single <@bl.key>Sprinkler</> can irrigate multiple plots in front of it.

dung_blackbox_thickener_1.name: Grinding Unit
dung_blackbox_thickener_1.desc: The AIC Factory can now utilize the Grinding Unit that uses Sandleaf Powder to grind materials into ultra-fine compressible particles for making higher quality medicine and gear.
dung_blackbox_thickener_1.featureDesc:
Place <@bl.key>Sandleaf Powder</> and Origocrust Powder in the <@bl.key>Grinding Unit</> to produce <@bl.key>Dense Origocrust Powder</>. 
Place Dense Origocrust Powder in the <@bl.key>Refining Unit</> to produce <@bl.key>Packed Origocrust</>. 
Place <@bl.key>Sandleaf Powder</> and Amethyst Powder in the <@bl.key>Grinding Unit</> to produce <@bl.key>Cryston Powder</>. 
Place Cryston Powder in the <@bl.key>Refining Unit</> to make <@bl.key>Cryston Fiber</>.

dung_blackbox_winder_1.name: Gearing Unit
dung_blackbox_winder_1.desc: Use the Gearing Unit to produce Amethyst Components.
dung_blackbox_winder_1.featureDesc: Use the <@bl.key>Gearing Unit</> to produce gear components. Use the <@bl.key>blueprint</> feature to quickly construct production lines.

dung_camille_chartrial.name: Combat Drills: Camille
dung_camille_chartrial.desc: Camille is a Heat element vanguard. He can summon <@ba.key>Firefang Vesperwings</> to apply <@ba.fire>Heat Infliction</>, <@ba.key>Weaken</>, and <@ba.fire>Heat Susceptibility</> on enemies, and use his combo skill and ultimate to restore lots of SP.

dung_mifu_chartrial.name: Combat Drills: Mi Fu
dung_mifu_chartrial.desc: Mi Fu is a Physical guard who can apply <@ba.phy>Physical Susceptibility</> and <@ba.phy>Crush</> to achieve a good DMG output. If her <@ba.phy>Crush</> consumes enough <@ba.phy>Vulnerability</> stacks, she can cast her battle skill again to deal an additional hit of massive DMG.

dung_tangtang_chartrial.name: Combat Drills: Tangtang
dung_tangtang_chartrial.desc: Tangtang is a caster who can effectively deal DMG to enemy mobs and apply Arts buffs. She can create <@ba.key>Whirlpools</> and whip up <@ba.key>Waterspouts</> from them to apply <@ba.cryst>Cryo Infliction</>. Her ultimate can also temporarily lock down enemies.

dung_wulfa_chartrial.name: Combat Drills: Rossi
dung_wulfa_chartrial.desc: Rossi is an operator who can quickly apply multiple stacks of <@ba.phy>Vulnerability</> and deal DMG of different elements. She can <@ba.key>consume</> <@ba.key>Arts Infliction</> to apply <@ba.phy>Lift</> and <@ba.phy>Vulnerability</>, and deals both <@ba.pd>Physical DMG</> and <@ba.fire>Heat DMG</> at the same time.

dung_yvonne_chartrial.name: Combat Drills: Yvonne
dung_yvonne_chartrial.desc: Yvonne is a DMG dealer who leverages her critical hits. Her ultimate makes her a powerful single-target DMG dealer.

dung_zhuangfy_chartrial.name: Combat Drills: Zhuang Fangyi
dung_zhuangfy_chartrial.desc: Zhuang Fangyi is a striker who can deal continuous and massive <@ba.pulse>Electric DMG</>. Her battle skills can create <@ba.key>Sunderblades</> that unleash Thunder Strikes on the enemy. Her ultimate also greatly enhances her combat capabilities.
